mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT semester_label FROM guestbook_notes WHERE state = 'normal' ORDER BY semester_label DESC
mapper.sql: n.note_id AS noteId, n.semester_label AS semesterLabel, n.display_name AS displayName, n.user_id AS userId, (n.user_id IS NOT NULL) AS isMember, n.content, n.ink, n.paper, n.tilt, n.state, n.created_at AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM guestbook_notes n WHERE n.state = 'normal' AND n.semester_label = #{semester} ORDER BY n.note_id DESC

SELECT ns.note_id AS noteId, ns.sticker_id AS stickerId, ns.slot, s.name, CONCAT('/api/guestbook/stickers/', s.sticker_id, '/image') AS imageUrl FROM guestbook_note_stickers ns JOIN guestbook_stickers s ON s.sticker_id = ns.sticker_id WHERE ns.note_id IN #{id} ORDER BY ns.note_id, ns.slot
mapper.sql: sticker_id AS stickerId, name, file_url AS fileUrl, file_type AS fileType, CONCAT('/api/guestbook/stickers/', sticker_id, '/image') AS imageUrl, sort_order AS sortOrder
mapper.select: SELECT FROM guestbook_stickers WHERE state = 'normal' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, sticker_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM guestbook_stickers WHERE state = 'normal' AND sticker_id IN #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guestbook_notes (semester_label, display_name, user_id, content, ink, paper, tilt, ip_hash) VALUES (#{n.semesterLabel}, #{n.displayName}, #{n.userId}, #{n.content}, #{n.ink}, #{n.paper}, #{n.tilt}, #{ipHash})
